name: Uncommon Microsoft Office Trusted Location Added
description: Detects changes to registry keys related to "Trusted Location" of Microsoft Office where the path is set to something uncommon. Attackers might add additional trusted locations to avoid macro security restrictions.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Other unknown legitimate or custom paths need to be filtered to avoid false positives
query: (registry.path:*Security\\Trusted\ Locations\\Location* AND registry.path:*\\Path) AND (NOT ((process.executable:*\:\\Program\ Files\\Common\ Files\\Microsoft\ Shared\\ClickToRun\\* AND process.executable:*\\OfficeClickToRun.exe) OR (process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Office\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\ Office\\*)))) AND (NOT (winlog.event_data.Details:(*%APPDATA%\\Microsoft\\Templates* OR *%%APPDATA%%\\Microsoft\\Templates* OR *%APPDATA%\\Microsoft\\Word\\Startup* OR *%%APPDATA%%\\Microsoft\\Word\\Startup* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\ Office\\root\\Templates\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Office\ \(x86\)\\Templates* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Office\\root\\Templates\\* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Office\\Templates\\*)))
